record.label: Difference-replica support-3+ K6 provider
record.summary: Independent review accepts the target-blind difference-replica law and its static accounting as a concrete support-3+ connected-K6 provider design. The frozen parent and diagnostic addendum specify 1,664 independent paths, an exact three-pool replica identity, exact seven-sector quotient algebra, six packed float64 degree maps per transition, a 645,765,427,200-FLOP diagnostic cap, and a projected 5,679,808,512-byte peak. Execution remains HOLD: RNG domains and path-pair custody are not bound; canonical row manifests, a runner, and a release are absent; realized split S,N ratios are empirical statistics, not a one-sided >=90% action-energy certificate; and no literal production meter, RSS receipt, or dual-stack sync-clean residual authority exists. No source gate, target, estimator, package, or submission is authorized. GATE-1 SCIENCE VERDICT (2026-08-29): the frozen 315-cell split action-energy screen was executed science-only on the three registered roles with bit-exact custody (per-role RNG stream hashes equal the registered path_stream values) and FAILED 0/315 cells: median N/|S| 29-46 versus the required <=1/9, 39-59 percent of cells with negative S. At 1/paths scaling the gate needs ~538k paths; their path GEMMs alone cost 7.7x the full 2^41 budget and the degree maps scale identically at 10x the size. The difference-replica support>=3 K6 source is experimentally falsified at every affordable path count; the frozen law forbids pooling rescue, seed retry, or rescale.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed: SCREEN_RESULT.json is the terminal receipt; any successor sampled-K6 source must first show at Gate 0 that its estimator variance at budget-compatible path counts can reach N/S<=1/9.
